170191: A girl who lost her father and her right arm due to a Gadoll attack when she was a child. She dreams of joining the Kanochikara and fight the Gadoll as a warrior, but reality bites, and ends up working under Kaburagi as an armor repairer. Cheerful, energetic, and reckless.
170192: Human Avatar Kaburagi is a middle aged man sporting greying black hair, which he slicks back, and facial hair on his chin. He wears a tucked-in wide necked short-sleeved shirt (with the sleeves tucked up and buttoned) with two buttons on the front.
174133: The Commander in Chief of Deca-dence. Calm, composed, and cerebral, he is irreplaceable in the fight against the Gadoll, as he is in charge of game plan building to emergency decision making.
174134: A friend of Natsume's who grew up in the same orphan home. She became a demolition worker after she left the home. She respects Natsume's dream to becoming a warrior, but always worries for her welfare. She felt relieved when Natsume became an armor repair worker.
174136: He is an armor repair worker in the Kaburagi Group, therefore, a senior co-worker of Natsume's. Although he is a half-baked repair worker, he kindly supports Natsume. Flippant with good beat, he often takes Natsume out for dinner.
174137: One of the strongest female warriors among the tankers in The Power. She spearheads her troop on the battlefields with her henchmen Sou and Ryu. Brave, but plenteous in mercy, she bundles her men together with her charisma. She is the object of Natsume's long-time admiration.
174138: A girl who grew up in the same orphan home Natsume lived in. She is always with her entourage. Linmei is ill at ease with Natsume, often picking a fight one way or another. She worked as a demolition worker after she left the home.
